title: Northern Alabama tour and W. C. Handy's birthplace
summary: The band plays towns in northern Alabama; in Florence he sees the house where W. C. Handy was born.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: We used to take trips up into northern Alabama. We played towns like Sheffield, Alabama; Tuscumbia, Alabama; Florence, Alabama; Decatur, Alabama; Athens, Alabama; Huntsville, Alabama. That was northern Alabama.

One tune in particular -- one town in particular we played in was Florence, Alabama. Florence was across the Tennessee River from Sheffield, Alabama. and in Florence there was a pool hall where we used to go and hang out and play pool
in the afternoons. And there was a house next door to the pool hall. And this house was where W. C. Handy was born. Florence, Alabama.
And I would walk out and look at the house, you know. And I just said, 'Well, at least I saw the house where he was born in Florence, Alabama.'
